mapper.insert: INSERT INTO F2F_NOTIFY_TASK ( NOTIFY_TYPE, TARGET, ORDER_NO, REFUND_NO, NOTIFY_STATUS, PAYLOAD, RETRY_TIMES, MAX_RETRY_TIMES, NEXT_RETRY_TMS, LAST_ERROR, SUCCESS_TMS, CREATE_TMS, UPDATE_TMS ) VALUES ( #{notifyType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{target,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{orderNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{refundNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{notifyStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{payload,jdbcType=CLOB}, #{retryTimes,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{maxRetryTimes,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{nextRetryTms,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{lastError,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{successTms,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{createTms,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{updateTms,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM F2F_NOTIFY_TASK WHERE NOTIFY_STATUS = 'PENDING' AND (NEXT_RETRY_TMS IS NULL OR NEXT_RETRY_TMS <= #{now,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}) ORDER BY NEXT_RETRY_TMS NULLS FIRST, ID FETCH FIRST #{limit,jdbcType=INTEGER} ROWS ONLY

SELECT FROM F2F_NOTIFY_TASK WHERE NOTIFY_STATUS = 'PENDING' AND NOTIFY_TYPE = #{notifyType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND (NEXT_RETRY_TMS IS NULL OR NEXT_RETRY_TMS <= #{now,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}) ORDER BY NEXT_RETRY_TMS NULLS FIRST, ID FETCH FIRST #{limit,jdbcType=INTEGER} ROWS ONLY
mapper.update: UPDATE F2F_NOTIFY_TASK SET NOTIFY_STATUS = 'SUCCESS', SUCCESS_TMS = #{successTms,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, NEXT_RETRY_TMS = NULL, UPDATE_TMS = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE ID = #{id,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND NOTIFY_STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED')

UPDATE F2F_NOTIFY_TASK SET RETRY_TIMES = RETRY_TIMES + 1, NOTIFY_STATUS = CASE WHEN RETRY_TIMES + 1 >= MAX_RETRY_TIMES THEN 'GIVEUP' ELSE 'PENDING' END, NEXT_RETRY_TMS = #{nextRetryTms,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, LAST_ERROR = #{lastError,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATE_TMS = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE ID = #{id,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND NOTIFY_STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED')
